question: Why did the frozen real UTF-8 maintenance policy fail: because raw error-bucket monitoring confuses deletion-induced errors with pre-existing natural prediction errors, because correct-repair validation gain is unstable across held-out quarters, or both?
authority: research-only diagnostic attribution; no intervention, repair, threshold update, deployment, or runtime authority

frozen_reuse.corpus: exact real UTF-8 pilot train/eval Git blobs
frozen_reuse.target_schedule: exact attribution-selected Tier 1 rule from WLM-YGG-REAL-UTF8-MAINTENANCE-SUPPORT-ATTRIBUTION-R1; first two eligible targets in each file
frozen_reuse.degradation: delete the scheduled motif record only

attribution.raw_monitor: On the diagnostic quarter, count all prediction errors by retained-catalog four-byte key under the degraded model exactly as R3 did; record target rank and target/runner-up ratio.
attribution.canonical_background: Run the intact canonical model on the same diagnostic quarter and count its naturally occurring errors by the same key.
attribution.excess_error_monitor: For every catalog key compute max(0,degraded_error_count-canonical_error_count); rank by excess count with lexicographic tie. This is evaluator-only diagnostic attribution and is not an authorized replacement policy.
attribution.validation_stability: On the independent validation quarter, compare selected-target top-1 accuracy and global BPB between deleted state and exact canonical restoration. No retain decision is made.
attribution.no_intervention: Each attribution cycle starts from canonical state, applies one deletion, measures, and discards state. There is no candidate installation, retain/revert, or sequential carryover.

attribution_classification_rules.dual_bottleneck: both background_error_confusion and validation_instability are true
attribution_classification_rules.unresolved: neither attribution condition explains the R3 failures
attribution_classification_rules.invalid: identity, target reconstruction, quarter isolation, completion, or deterministic attribution fails

validity_criteria: Exact parent, prior negative evidence, canonical model, Tier 1 targets, corpus identities, and quarter boundaries match R3.
Every deletion is analyzed independently from canonical state; no sequential carryover.
Canonical background errors are evaluator-only diagnostics and are never used to repair or retain anything.
Validation compares exact deleted versus exact canonical-restored state only; no candidate policy executes.
No tokenizer, capacity growth, lesion label access by a policy, intervention, or post-result threshold change occurs.
Full Go regression passes and normalized result carries exact experiment identity.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not change targets, corpus, quarter split, raw-error definition, background subtraction, ranking, validation comparison, metrics, or attribution classification after observing output.
